notes: Sub-study of a master protocol. First-page sentence, verbatim (p1): "This study H0P-MC-NP03 (NCT04707157) is a sub-study of Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (NCT05986292)". The document is the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-NP03 to master protocol H0P-MC-CPMP and is used together with the DPNP disease-state addendum (DSA; CPMP(3)). Nothing was filled from the master. Deferrals to the master protocol / DPNP DSA as stated in this document: SoA (p9 'Please refer to master protocol and the DPNP DSA SoAs for additional information'; p4 'AEs for the rest of the study are covered in the master CPMP SoA'); objectives and endpoints (p7, p16); eligibility criteria (p19; SoA row 'Evaluate all I/E criteria' - only the LY3556050-specific criteria [3025]-[3041] are printed here); concomitant therapy (p23); discontinuation (p26); study procedures and their timing (p27 8. 'summarized in the SoAs contained in the master protocol CPMP, DPNP DSA, and this ISA'); AEs/SAEs (p27 8.2; SoA row 'AEs'); clinical laboratory tests (p31: 'The master protocol describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA. This table describes tests unique for ISA NP03.'); statistics (p29); vital signs follow the Manual of Operations (p27). SoA rows the text does not describe in this document (composition/method deferred to the master or not printed): Hematology, Chemistry (only the NP03-unique chemistry tests Cystatin-C, TSH, Bicarbonate, Anion gap, eGFR are listed), Lipid panel, Urine drug screen, Serum pregnancy (only listed as 'Serum pregnancy test' under Other Tests), Thyroid panel (no table of that name; the p31 table has 'Additional Thyroid Tests' and TSH under Chemistry, p15 says 'Labs evaluated at each visit to monitor thyroid function' - not linked to the row by name, so no lab_and_purpose entry), HbA1c (only listed under Other Tests), Somatostatin-regulated hormone sample (the p31 column is headed 'Other SST-Regulated Hormones'; not linked by name, so recorded only as a panel), Study intervention, Intervention compliance (p23 6.4 describes capsule records), Participant returns device (its SoA Notes cell is redacted 'CCI'; p41 amendment history: 'Added participant digital biomarker device for Visit 7 and ED - To indicate when the participant needs to return the device'). Instruments: none named for an SoA activity of this ISA SoA - empty list. The document mentions 'Numeric Rating Scale (NRS) diary entries' (p17, p18) as study restrictions/diary review, but no ISA SoA row; diaries and questionnaires are governed by the master/DSA. Panels: specimen and lab not stated for the p31/p32 tables. Lab: the only central/local statement is the exceptional-circumstances provision (p38 'Local laboratory testing may be conducted in lieu of central laboratory testing'; 'If local testing is used, PK and exploratory biomarker sample collection may not occur'), not recorded per activity. Rule 10: the p31 lab-tests table (4 columns) runs its columns together in the text layer; panel assignments were read from the page image of p31; p32 (Thyroid Safety Follow-Up, one column) checked visually too. Quotes are from the text layer. Text-layer artefact: many pages (e.g. 5, 7, 10-13, 16-17, 22-25, 28-31) carry a letter-spaced text layer ('E C G', 'P K'); quotes, and the abbreviation terms/definitions taken from p13 and p31, are copied in that spaced form so they match the text layer; field values are given in normal spelling. ECG components differ between the SoA note (p10: PR interval, QRS duration and interval, heart rate) and Section 8.1.2 (p27: heart rate, PR, QRS, QT and QTcF intervals); both recorded in the one ECG entry with both evidence quotes. Redactions ('CCI'): schema (p8), objectives/endpoints table (p16), dose titration scheme in 6.6 (p23-p25; the 6.6 cross-reference target is found but the titration scheme itself is redacted), sample size details (p29), parts of p7, p28, p30, p31; SoA telephone-visit notes a and b (p10-p13) and the 'Participant returns device' notes cell are redacted. No page reads '[no text layer on this page]'; no entries are marked read_from page image. Protocol version (rule 11): the PDF holds only Amendment (b) (approved 01 Oct 2021); the SoA (pp 9-13) is from that version. Earlier changes are listed in the amendment history only: Amendment (b) added the follow-up visit and the AEs row (p4) and added bicarbonate, anion gap and eGFR by CKD-EPI based upon cystatin c (p4); Amendment (a) replaced Urinalysis with Urine drug screen, added a PK sample window and the participant digital biomarker device (p41). No later amendment in the PDF. Abbreviations: the Appendix 4 list (p40, 21 entries) plus abbreviations defined only under the SoA table (p13: ECG, ED, HbA1c, I/E, V) and the lab-tests table (p31: CKD-EPI). All tokens in SoA activity names (I/E, ECG, AEs, PK, HbA1c) are defined; ECG is not in the Appendix 4 list (defined under the SoA table p13 and the risk table p15); HR (p15), IMP/NIMP (p22) are defined under other tables and not listed. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind; letter-spaced abbreviation terms and definitions re-spaced (whitespace only, checked from page images).
